description: A searchable chunk derived from a registered local source document.

properties.name: chunkId
properties.description: Stable chunk id from document id, chunk index, and content hash.

properties.name: documentId
properties.description: Document id from the state store.

properties.name: projectId
properties.description: Stable project id from the source registry.

properties.name: sourceId
properties.description: Stable source root id from the source registry.

properties.name: sourceType
properties.description: Registered source type.

properties.name: ssotRole
properties.description: Truth role used for search scoping.

properties.name: relativePath
properties.description: Path relative to the source root.

properties.name: fileName
properties.description: File name for exact and BM25 matching.

properties.name: folder
properties.description: Parent folder path relative to source root.

properties.name: extension
properties.description: Source file extension.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Document title from frontmatter, first H1, or file name.

properties.name: docType
properties.description: Document type from frontmatter or path-derived defaults.

properties.name: frontmatterStatus
properties.description: Document status from frontmatter, such as current, active, draft, deprecated, or superseded.

properties.name: authority
properties.description: Document authority class, such as canonical, accepted, reference, raw, or source-default.

properties.name: updated
properties.description: Canonical updated timestamp from frontmatter or file mtime.

properties.name: supersedes
properties.description: Document ids or paths replaced by this document.

properties.name: supersededBy
properties.description: Document ids or paths that supersede this document.

properties.name: headingPath
properties.description: Full Markdown heading hierarchy for citation.

properties.name: headingPathSegments
properties.description: Full heading hierarchy as individual title/heading segments.

properties.name: headingDepth
properties.description: Current Markdown heading depth for section-aware ranking.

properties.name: headingSlug
properties.description: Stable normalized heading anchor for citations.

properties.name: chunkContext
properties.description: Generated title, document metadata, and heading summary prepended to chunk text.

properties.name: chunkIndex
properties.description: Chunk order in document.

properties.name: content
properties.description: Chunk text used for BM25 and context.

properties.name: contentHash
properties.description: SHA-256 hash of normalized chunk content.

properties.name: sensitivity
properties.description: Sensitivity classification from metadata or source default.

properties.name: tags
properties.description: Extracted tags.

properties.name: links
properties.description: Extracted markdown links or local references.

properties.name: fileMtimeNs
properties.description: Source file modification time in nanoseconds.

properties.name: indexedAt
properties.description: Indexing timestamp.
